scores.evidence: Three can-do objectives with Bloom levels: o1 analyze, o2 apply, o3 analyze. Each is assessed at least twice outside the ungraded q0: o1 by q1, q2, e1 and e2; o2 by q3 (apply), e3 (apply, transfer to `~/.aws/`) and e4; o3 by q4, e5 and e6. lessons:lint --strict reports 0 warnings.

hook-b1 sets a concrete scene in 3 sentences (「知らないリポジトリをcloneし…」「`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` が残っています」) and then asks 「何が起こりうるでしょうか。」. The predict question q0 is a multi-select, and its explanation points ahead to 10-1, 10-2 and 10-5. There is no trivia or statistics.

Prerequisites list 第2回 and 第5回 through 第9回. New terms are defined before use: プロンプトインジェクション in s1-defs, VM glossed in s1-practices, ワークスペースの信頼 and サンドボックス in s2-defs, クラウドセッション inline in s2-isolate, エフォート in s5-md2 before s5-table. A few terms are never explained: `/status` (s5-table, e5, practice), `--bare` (s2-isolate) and Console (e5).

measure.mjs gives 「prose 1887 (budget 1,200–2,400) · est 17.3 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 17)」, and lint is clean. Every segment ends with a table, diagram or check. s2 is at the 3-new-term limit and also brings in Seatbelt, bubblewrap and `--bare`. The second paragraph of s5-md2 strings three unrelated asides together (`-p` and the key, `/clear` versus `/compact`, the definition of エフォート).

s3-steps is a worked example with 4 labelled subgoals, each with an expect, followed by s3-code and then q3. p-deny applies the same form to `.env` and `secrets/` (hint 「10-3の `keys/**` と同じ形です。」). ex-target gives no reason, and the audit and bill parts of the practice have no worked example besides the lookup tables.

Inline checks follow s1, s2, s3 and s5; only s4 has none, so there are never 2 content sections in a row without a check. q1 (`curl … | bash` from a web page), q3 (`certs/**`) and q4 (Pro limit after chat use) are application scenarios. q2 (「知らない人の公開リポジトリを試したいとき、公式ドキュメントが勧める方法」) can be answered by looking up s2-table row 2 just above it.

Every wrong option has feedback of at most 2 sentences that names a real misconception and gives the reason. For example, q1-d 「CLAUDE.mdは助言で、強制ではありません」, q2-b sandbox scope, q3-d `.claudeignore`, e3-b single `/`, e5-b 「`/usage` の金額は手元の見積もり」 and e6-a 「`/compact` は…それ自体が大きな要求」. These match the brief's misconception list 1–7.

s2-layers is a 5-node structural diagram with Japanese labels, a caption and alt text. There are no images and both tables have 2 columns. But the caption 「VMやクラウドセッションはClaude Code全体を…囲みます」 describes a layer that is not drawn. The edge label 「サンドボックスの中」 suggests the sandbox is always on, although s2-defs says 「既定はオフです」.

An authentic audit of 田中さん's settings and habits leads to a hands-on deny-rule test in a dummy folder (with a prediction before sending practice-prompt-read) and a bill explanation. There is a 4-item checklist and model answers (practice-answer-rule, practice-prompt-review.expect). The hint ladder is shallow: p-audit has one hint, and p-bill's troubleshoot already gives the answer. practice-case-habits states 「`.env` と `secrets/` に拒否ルールがない」 outright.

The summary section comes after the exam. It has 3 points, a reflection question (「自分の環境で、田中さんと同じ状態になっているものはありますか。」), a next step to 第11回, 7 flashcards that each test a distinct point (for example card-clear and card-usage), and askTutor suggestions.

The version is pinned in the subtitle (v2.1.304), and every factual block cites official pages. The fixes from audit-cc-10-safety-cost.json are applied: the 17% figure is dated to 「2026年3月の公式記事」, the auto default is scoped to the terminal and VS Code, and s2-isolate names hooks and `.mcp.json`. Path forms match cross-lesson-facts.md items 4–5. s2-table row 3 「確認なしで何でも動く」 conflicts with the glossary's 拒否ルール 「どの権限モードでも効きます」 (see niceToHave).

The text is consistently です・ます, warm and free of banned phrases, and katakana terms carry their English on first use. The offline case is worded three ways: 「オフラインのコンテナかVMだけで使う」 (s2-table), 「ネットにつながらないコンテナやVMの中で使う」 (e2-b) and 「ネットにつながらない隔離環境」 (e1-b).

The only locale is jp. Link texts are descriptive (「セキュリティの公式ドキュメント」, 「公式の料金ページ」). The diagram labels are Japanese and s2-layers has full alt text. Plain-text fields (checklist labels, var hints, captions) avoid markdown. The alt describes a VM enclosure that the diagram does not draw.

niceToHave: s2-check q2: make it a scenario that needs analysis rather than a lookup in s2-table row 2. For example, use the prompt 「友人から『このリポジトリのセットアップを手伝って』とURLが届きました。中身は見たことがありません。どう始めますか？」 and keep the options and feedback.

check-quiz e6: o3 is 「原因を特定できる」, but e6 asks for a remedy and states the cause in the stem. Consider the prompt 「1日じゅう同じセッションで関係のない作業を次々に頼んでいたら、使用量の減りが早くなりました。主な原因はどれでしょう？」, with the answer 「それまでの履歴全体を、毎回送り直している」 and distractors built from the current options.

factual doubt: s2-table row 3 says 「確認なしで何でも動く」, but the glossary (拒否ルール) and e4-b say deny rules work in every mode. The audit kept the cell because it matches the docs' summary table. To remove the internal tension, consider 「強い権限（`bypassPermissions`）：拒否ルール以外は確認なしで動く」 and check it against the permission-modes page.

s2-layers: the caption and alt describe a VM layer that is not drawn, and the edge 「サンドボックスの中」 hides that the sandbox is off by default. Change the edge label to 「サンドボックス（オン時）の中」, or draw the outer layer as a mobile-safe subgraph and re-check the preview at 390 px.
s2-layers: hooks are said to run outside the sandbox (s2-sandbox, e2-c, card-sandbox), but the diagram does not show them. Consider adding a node such as `F["リポジトリのフック"]` with `C -->|サンドボックスの外| F`.
s5-table row 1 and the practice rely on `/status`, which the lesson never explains. Add a few words to the action cell, for example 「`/status` で使っている認証を確かめ、キーを外す」.
s5-md2: its second paragraph holds three unrelated asides. Move each next to its table row: 「（`-p` では承認なしで使われる）」 to row 1, and 「`/compact` はそれ自体が大きな要求」 to row 2. Keep the エフォート definition in s5-md2.
practice-case-habits: 「`.env` と `secrets/` に拒否ルールがない」 names the problem for the learner. Consider the neutral observation 「プロジェクトに `.env` と `secrets/` があり、`.claude/settings.json` は置いていない」.

practice-folder: `mkdir cc-practice-10` runs wherever the terminal happens to be. Consider making `cd ~` the first line, so the folder is not created inside `cc-practice`, which already holds a deny rule from 第2回.
s3-steps ex-target gives no reason for the step. Consider 「漏れると困る鍵のファイルを挙げます。Claudeが読んだ中身は、会話としてAnthropicに送られます。」 (wording for ja-editor).
Use one phrase for the offline case across s2-table, e1-b, e2-b, the e2 explanation and practice-prompt-review ①, for example 「ネットにつながらないコンテナやVM」 (wording for ja-editor).
summary: This is a full review: the earlier review chain was recorded under the old course path. The lesson content hash (sha256:8a9d7701d14a41d6) is unchanged since the move. Strongest point: tight alignment, with every objective assessed by inline and exam items whose feedback names a real misconception, plus a hands-on deny-rule test in a dummy folder. No must-fix items; the most useful improvements are making q2 a scenario instead of a table lookup, making e6 test the cause in line with o3, and drawing the diagram layer its caption promises.
